why: Does XH3's MP2 lead over Xater survive a bigger basis? corr-1's largest basis gave 2.4 kcal/mol, all of it correlation, with Xater's share still falling (+0.64, +0.42, +0.48, +0.05 kcal/mol as the basis grew). In our water a second f on oxygen closes a quarter of the gap to aug-cc-pVQZ and a d on hydrogen nothing, so: both 4D pairs with two f (F), Xater with a d on hydrogen (h) to check that holds in 4D, and our water, HF and ammonia in the same bases (water also with a g) to calibrate against aug-cc-pVQZ. XH3 in two f needs ~10 GB of integrals, so the 4D pairs get a runner each.
